inputs.brief: evals/briefs/04-miniprogram-list-zh.md, cut at the judge-notes line

claims.claim: 每行最醒目的是「最早可约」时间块（今天 = 实心品牌绿，明天 = 浅绿底，更晚 = 灰底）
claims.evidence: list.png: row 1 '今天 16:00' is a solid dark-green block with white text. Rows 2–3 '明天 09:00/14:00' are light-green blocks with a green outline. No later-date row appears in the first screen, so the grey case cannot be seen.

claims.claim: 价格用黑色粗体放在右下角，不用促销红
claims.evidence: list.png: ¥129起, ¥89/台 and ¥159/台 are black and bold at the bottom right of each row. No red is used.

claims.claim: 已服务次数保留 brief 的完整数字（12,480 次），不改写成「1.2 万」
claims.evidence: list.png: row 1 reads '已服务 12,480 次', and the other rows read 3,216 and 1,905.

claims.claim: 导航内容（位置切换）右边界约 216 px，与胶囊保持 >60 px 间距
claims.evidence: list.png: the location text and its chevron end near x≈213 CSS px. The capsule placeholder starts near x≈281, so the gap is more than 60 px and nothing overlaps the capsule.
list.png, filter.png and empty.png: the status bar reads 13:20 at top left.

claims.claim: 筛选面板做成挂在排序栏下方的下拉面板，而不是底部弹层…遮罩只盖列表区域
claims.evidence: filter.png: the panel opens directly below the sort bar and ends above the tab bar. A grey scrim strip is visible between the panel and the tab bar. The native tab bar is not covered.

claims.claim: 类目标签横向滚动，右侧渐隐 + 「全部类目」展开按钮
claims.evidence: list.png: the 5th tab, '管道…', fades out at the right edge, and a down-chevron button follows it. The '全部类目' label itself is not visible as text.

claims.claim: 筛选面板每组标题右侧的提示（「改成明天：6 个」「放宽到 3 km 内：4 个」「去掉「可开发票」：1 个」）…价格组没有提示
claims.evidence: filter.png: all three hints appear to the right of 上门时间, 距离 and 服务保障. The 价格 group has no hint.

claims.claim: 「服务人员」默认选中「不限」…不计入筛选数 3
claims.evidence: filter.png: 不限 is shown as selected, and the 筛选 badge reads 3. The selected chips are 今天, 1 km 内 and 可开发票.

claims.claim: 筛选打开时「筛选」按钮显示按下状态和收起箭头
claims.evidence: filter.png: the 筛选 button has a light-green pressed background with an up-caret (^) and badge 3. In empty.png it shows the funnel icon instead.

claims.claim: 空状态的放宽建议按结果数从多到少排序（明天 6 > 3 km 4 > 发票 1）…已选条件以可移除的标签显示在顶部
claims.evidence: empty.png: rows are ordered 改成明天上门 6 个服务, 放宽到 3 km 内 4 个服务, 去掉「可开发票」1 个服务, each with a chevron. At the top are chips 今天 ×, 1 km 内 × and 可开发票 ×. That tapping applies a change cannot be seen in a static render.

claims.claim: 三屏的对比度、溢出、无名控件、44 px 触控目标全部通过
claims.evidence: facts.md: text below AA is 0/52, 0/47 and 0/34. Targets under 44 px: 0 on all three screens. There is no horizontal overflow and no images without alt.

notes: Only the first screen of the list is visible, so the '更晚 = 灰底' time-block variant cannot be seen. Also consistent with NOTES but left out of the list: 「查看结果（0 个）」 is a primary button, and the selected tab-bar item changes colour but is not bold. 「最小字号 12 px」 could not be checked from the renders or facts.
